sub: Write one message and it goes to every farmer in the app ({n} farmers now). Kurdish is shown first; English is for farmers who chose English.
need_title: Write a title in Kurdish or English.
need_body: Write the message in Kurdish or English.
rule_note: Keep it short and clear: what happens, when, and what to do. No doses and no product names.
preview: How it looks on a phone
preview_note: Farmers see the Kurdish text. If the Kurdish is empty they see the English.
confirm_text: This alert goes to all {n} farmers in the app right away. A sent alert cannot be called back.
delete_text: The draft is deleted. Sent alerts cannot be deleted.
sent_locked: A sent alert cannot be changed. Copy it to send a correction.
